features: Keeps the established Scoring Tests Dashboard design for both Manual and Automatic test modes
Automatic Test replaces only the existing Manual Heats Score Entry block with Judge Live Scoring in the same screen position
Adds secure per-judge test URLs with Copy, Open and Regenerate actions plus live Not Started, Scoring and Submitted status
Shows live judge scoring progress and keeps submitted judge sessions locked through the existing test judge browser workflow
Adds inline delete controls for individual test judges, Delete All Judges, Delete All Competitors and Clear Entire Test Round
Existing competitor Remove controls remain in place for individual competitor removal
Manual Test keeps the current manual score-entry table unchanged
Manual and Automatic test calculations continue through the same shared BDC scoring engine
No Staging or Production deployment performed
